title: AO-MA AI Suggestion Register (AO-MA-11F-1)
description: Per-slice record of every cross-AI objection (Codex / Claude / Mavis review threads) with its disposition and rationale. Implements the CLAUDE.md §15 rule that each cross-AI objection is recorded accept/reject/partial with rationale. Pure evidence artifact: no secrets (free text is machine-redacted, no_secret_payload asserted only after the redaction verifies clean), no release authority, no I/O. A reject OR partial disposition MUST carry a non-empty rationale; an accept MUST carry either an applied_ref or a no_op rationale (closing evidence). An empty register is valid ONLY with an explicit harvest_mode + register_status=no_objections (never an implicit 'no records means no objections' fail-open).

harvest_mode.comment: How the objections were collected. 'provided' = injected records (AO-MA-11F-1, no GH read). 'gh_review_threads' = harvested from PR review threads (AO-MA-11F-2). 'not_applicable' = a slice with no cross-AI review surface. An empty register is only honest when the mode explains why.

register_status.comment: Distinguishes 'no objections recorded' from 'objections complete'. no_objections requires an empty array AND a harvest_mode that explains the emptiness.

expected_objections_count.comment: The number of objections the harvest expected to record. coverage = (len(objections) == expected) is cross-checked by the compiler; a register cannot claim 'all handled' if actual != expected.

objection_digest.comment: sha256 of the canonical (provider, source_kind, source_id, iteration, raw_objection) tuple. Stable identity so duplicate / missing coverage cannot hide behind free-text drift.

allOf.comment: reject OR partial requires a non-empty rationale.
accept requires closing evidence: either an applied_ref (the commit that applied it) OR a no-op rationale.
no_objections requires an empty array. The compiler additionally requires a harvest_mode that explains the emptiness (provided-with-zero-expected or not_applicable).
complete requires at least one recorded objection (otherwise use no_objections).
